meta.name: Corvit Systems Knowledge Base
meta.source_policy: Official Corvit Systems website first. Dynamic information such as schedules, fees, seats and offers must be verified from the linked official source before being presented as current.
meta.purpose: Ground the website chatbot in official Corvit information while allowing student guidance and course recommendations.

institute.name: Corvit Systems
institute.focus: IT training and professional technical education

head_office.address: 11A-D1, Ghalib Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan

institute.official_description: Corvit provides practical IT training covering networking, cybersecurity, cloud computing, DevOps, operating systems, programming, web development, graphic design, SEO and other ICT technologies.

official_claims: Corvit says it was founded in 2000.
Corvit says it has trained more than 150,000 students in classrooms and conducted 200+ corporate trainings on its introduction page.

Corvit's About Us page lists large numbers of certified professionals and 7,000+ corporate trainings; these figures are historical/marketing claims and should not be treated as a live enrollment count.

features: 24x7 lab access is stated on Corvit's introduction/about pages

course_documents.name: CCNA
course_documents.summary: CCNA covers network fundamentals, network access, IP connectivity, IP services, security fundamentals, automation and programmability. Corvit states classroom and online delivery.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: Good starting point for a fresher who wants a networking career.

course_documents.name: CCNP Enterprise
course_documents.summary: CCNP Enterprise builds on networking foundations and covers enterprise architecture, virtualization, QoS, IP services, routing, automation, security and network assurance. Corvit describes core and concentration exams.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: Best approached after a solid CCNA/networking foundation.

course_documents.name: Cyber Security
course_documents.summary: Corvit's cybersecurity outline covers cybersecurity fundamentals, lab setup using VMware/EVE-NG/Kali Linux, threats and attack vectors, information gathering, vulnerability assessment, Linux, social engineering, system hacking, network security and cloud security.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: A fresher can start, but basic networking and Linux knowledge will make the learning path easier.

course_documents.name: Certified Ethical Hacking (CEH v12)
course_documents.summary: Corvit describes CEHv12 training covering ethical hacking fundamentals, reconnaissance, scanning, enumeration, vulnerability analysis, system hacking, malware threats, sniffing, social engineering, wireless security, mobile platforms, IoT/OT, cloud and cryptography. Corvit states it is an EC-Council training partner.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: Networking fundamentals and Linux are strongly helpful before advanced ethical hacking.

course_documents.name: Cloud Computing
course_documents.summary: Corvit's cloud outline covers Windows Server/Active Directory, storage, DNS/DHCP, load balancing, failover, disaster recovery, VPN, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, GCP and Terraform.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: Networking and Linux fundamentals are useful; AWS/Azure/GCP should be selected according to career goal.

course_documents.name: DevOps
course_documents.summary: Corvit's DevOps course covers Linux, networking/security, AWS, Azure, Bash, PowerShell, Python, YAML, Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, ARM templates, CloudFormation, Ansible, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK and web servers.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: Best after basic Linux, networking and programming/scripting foundations.

course_documents.name: Python
course_documents.summary: Corvit's Python page covers problem solving, algorithms, coding, decision/repetition statements, OOP, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, Python databases, an e-commerce app, React and Python backend topics.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: Strong beginner-friendly starting point for students interested in programming, AI, automation or backend development.

course_documents.name: Artificial Intelligence
course_documents.summary: Corvit describes AI training around AI, machine learning, AI engineering, intelligent applications, predictive analysis, reinforcement learning, cognitive computing and quantum computing.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: For a fresher, learn Python and basic mathematics/statistics before moving deeply into ML/DL.

course_documents.name: Web Development
course_documents.summary: Corvit offers web development training and states the program is intended to improve career prospects and practical web-development skills.
course_documents.prerequisite_guidance: Good choice for a fresher who wants visible project work and freelance/web-development opportunities.

course_documents.name: More Courses
course_documents.summary: Corvit's More Courses page lists Amazon VA, Shopify, HCIA Storage, HCIA Cloud, Digital Marketing, Artificial Intelligence, Python and PMP Training.

paid_training.definition: Paid training means regular Corvit training outside a government-funded NAVTTC seat unless a specific offer says otherwise.
paid_training.rule: Do not invent or hard-code a fee if the fee image/page has changed. Tell the user the current official fee structure is published on the Lahore Fee page and should be verified with Corvit.

payment_policy.on_campus: FAQ says campus fees are accepted in cash or cheque.
payment_policy.online: FAQ says online students can transfer via bank or PayPal.
payment_policy.normal_payment: FAQ says full payment is normally required at the beginning; certain deserving students may be allowed two equal installments.
payment_policy.corporate: FAQ says corporate training is charged 100% in advance.

navttc.funding: Corvit states NAVTTC programs are fully funded by the Government of Pakistan for eligible students.
admission_process: Complete NAVTTC registration online or at campus
navttc.eligibility_note: Corvit's NAVTTC page says Pakistani students who meet NAVTTC education and age requirements can apply and that most courses require at least Intermediate. Exact eligibility is program/batch dependent.
navttc.seats_note: Corvit says seats are limited and in high demand. Individual NAVTTC outlines may specify class size.
navttc.certificate: Corvit states NAVTTC programs include official NAVTTC certification on completion.
navttc.answer_rule: Never tell a user that every Corvit course is free. Explain the difference between regular/paid training and NAVTTC-funded programs.

pseb.availability_note: Corvit's PSEB page says these trainings are offered on campus and eligibility criteria apply.
programs: Designing and Implementing a Data Science Solution on Azure

current_schedule.important_rule: This schedule is dynamic. When a user asks for timetable, prefer current_schedule.entries and source_image over older homepage offers.

admission_and_student_guidance.general_admission_rule: Use the official inquiry/admission page or contact Corvit for current batch availability, eligibility and enrollment.
admission_and_student_guidance.certificate: Corvit's FAQ says a training completion certificate is issued at the end of each course.
admission_and_student_guidance.online_students: Corvit says students living away from campus can use online training.
admission_and_student_guidance.course_duration: Corvit's FAQ says course duration varies by course; do not invent a universal duration for regular paid courses.

beginner_guidance.rule: Do not assume every beginner should start with an advanced certification.

paths.why: Python provides a practical programming foundation and can lead toward web, automation, data or AI.
CCNA establishes networking fundamentals before advanced enterprise networking.

recommended_sequence: CEH or a specialized security track
paths.why: Security work becomes easier when networking and Linux fundamentals are strong.
Cloud infrastructure depends heavily on networking, operating systems, security and automation.
Programming and mathematical foundations make AI training more productive.

course_recommendation_questions: Are you a complete beginner or do you already know networking/programming/Linux?
Which area interests you most: networking, cybersecurity, cloud, AI, programming, web development or design?
Do you want a certification-focused path, job skills, freelancing, or a long-term engineering path?
Do you need online or on-campus training?
Do you need a free NAVTTC-funded option?

faq.q: How are regular course fees paid?
faq.answer: The FAQ says on-campus students can pay by cash or cheque; online students can transfer via bank or PayPal. Full payment is normally required at the beginning, with some deserving students allowed two equal installments.
Corvit states its NAVTTC programs are fully funded by the Government of Pakistan for eligible students. This does not mean every Corvit course is free.

faq.q: Does Corvit have a Sahiwal branch?
faq.answer: There is a conflict in Corvit's official Systems pages: the FAQ says there is no Sahiwal branch, while the contact page lists a 'Corvit Sahiwal' address. The chatbot should not state a definite current branch without verification.

grounding_priority: 1. Match exact/near-exact FAQ, schedule, fee, course or intent record in dataset.
2. Retrieve the most relevant knowledge_documents/course records.
3. Use GPT-OSS-120B only to synthesize an answer from retrieved Corvit context.
4. If model/API fails, answer from deterministic dataset templates.
5. If the dataset does not contain the fact, say that it is not verified and provide the relevant official Corvit page/contact.
no_hallucination: Never invent seats for regular paid courses.
Never turn a related/consulting office into a Systems training campus.
Never claim a schedule is current without checking current_schedule.
Never claim an image proves a current facility inventory.
Never present general career guidance as an official Corvit promise.

show_images_when: a course or facility response has a highly relevant official image

fallback.unknown_image_fallback: I could not find a verified official Corvit image for that request.
